mechanism: Both drugs possess anticholinergic and CNS depressant properties that may be additive, with fluoxetine also inhibiting meclizine metabolism via CYP3A4 and CYP2D6.
action: Monitor for increased anticholinergic effects (dry mouth, urinary retention, constipation) and CNS depression (sedation, dizziness); consider dose adjustment or alternative antiemetic if adverse effects occur.
